## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: driving test requirements
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The knowledge-test count and passing standard are printed in the same paragraph, and the signs test paragraph uses the same percentage with a different count [A01].
The handbook gives an expected duration for the knowledge test, about forty-five minutes, rather than a stated time limit, so no limit is asserted [A01] (verify WI-TEST-A-TIME).
The C misconception that a defective car can stop the road test is an inference from the examiner's pre-test safety check; the page says the examiner makes sure the car is safe to drive but does not spell out what happens if it is not [A02] (verify WI-TEST-D-VEHICLE).
The vision paragraph names regular car and motorcycle applicants together; no separate standard for other classes is stated on these pages [A01].
The online test fee, online age range, service center hours and DMV web addresses are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The Wisconsin Motorists Handbook prints 2026 on its front cover and form number BDS126 with 2026 on its back cover; it is a yearly-dated handbook with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: The skills test paragraph (physical page 6) says the examiner checks the horn, lights, signals, plates, doors and mirrors to make sure the car is safe, but does not state the consequence of an unsafe car; confirm with the WisDOT DMV road test page before teaching it as a rule.
